name: OpenSfM Reconstruction Loader & Coordinate Transformation
aliases: OpenSfM Pose and Point Cloud Loading
definition: Loads camera poses, intrinsics, and point clouds from OpenSfM's reconstruction.json and image_list.txt, converts poses to OpenGL-compatible coordinate system, normalizes focal lengths, and applies auto-scaling/centering to the scene.
summary: This tool loads OpenSfM data and converts its coordinate system to OpenGL for volume rendering, differing from COLMAP loaders by handling OpenSfM's specific JSON structure.
